title: All-Time Great Indian War & Military Films
description: 10 outstanding Indian films centred primarily on soldiers, armed forces, battlefield operations, military sacrifice and the human cost of war.

entries.why_it_ranks: J.P. Dutta's Battle of Longewala epic remains the definitive mainstream Indian war film, combining memorable battlefield sequences with the personal lives of its soldiers.
One of the foundational Indian war films, portraying the 1962 Sino-Indian War with tragedy, sacrifice and considerably less triumphalism than many later military movies.
A superb combination of coming-of-age drama and Kargil battlefield film, with Hrithik Roshan's transformation giving the military story a strong human centre.
One of India's most technically accomplished modern military-action films, particularly strong in combat staging, sound and tactical presentation.
Captain Vikram Batra's Kargil story combines battlefield courage with enough personal background to make his eventual sacrifice emotionally powerful.
An underrated POW film about Indian soldiers attempting to escape captivity following the 1971 war, with tension taking precedence over spectacle.
India's standout submarine-war film, creating tension almost entirely within the confined environment of an underwater military confrontation.
A rare Indian World War II film that parallels conflict on the European battlefield with caste divisions back home.
One of Indian cinema's most thoughtful depictions of military training and service, following an uncertain young man into the Indian Air Force.
Flawed and extremely long, but its enormous attempt to reconstruct multiple Kargil operations and honour numerous soldiers gives it a unique place in Indian war cinema.
